name: Magical Twirler Angel Rabbie
original_name: まじかるトワラー・エンジェルラビィ
source:
In a faraway border town called Fonteille, far from the royal capital, there lived a very cute girl.
The girl's name is Lasty. She has differently colored eyes, one red and one violet, and is a kind-hearted girl who cares deeply for her mother.
Lasty lost her ability to speak when she was young. However, she was able to sing beautifully.
One day, as Lasty went to the church as usual to run an errand, a mysterious cat appeared from nowhere and began to speak to her.
The cat that can communicate with Lasty through her heart is the cat spirit Saaria. It has appeared to take Lasty to a mysterious corridor.
There was a beautiful angel with red hair who said to Lasty: "I come from the heavens, my name is Stefa, and Fonteille is in danger, for you, lucky one, here's a special treat from me: The Super Delicious Planet Golden Special Reserve Gorgeous Aftercare Baton No. 28. For short, I present to you the Angel Holy Baton. Right now, as part of the campaign, it also comes with a Salmon and Trout strap".
Lasty, caught up in the moment, ended up accepting the baton.
translation:
在远离王都的边境小镇丰泰尔，生活着一名非常可爱的少女。
少女名叫菈丝蒂，双眼颜色不同，一只是红色，另一只是紫色。她心地善良，也十分关心母亲。
菈丝蒂幼年时失去了说话能力，却依然能够唱出美妙歌声。
一天，她像往常一样前往教堂办事，一只神秘猫咪突然不知从何处现身，还开口与她说话。
这只能够通过心灵与菈丝蒂交流的猫，是猫精灵萨莉雅。它前来引领菈丝蒂走进一条神秘长廊。
长廊里有一位美丽的红发天使，她对菈丝蒂说道：“我来自天界，名叫斯特法。丰泰尔正面临危机。幸运的孩子，这是我特别送给你的超级美味行星黄金特藏豪华售后服务棒第28号。简称天使圣杖。现在正值促销期间，还附赠鲑鱼与鳟鱼挂件。”
菈丝蒂顺着当时的气氛，稀里糊涂地接下了圣杖。
